detail.title: WENTE 220 USB Condenser Microphone - Cardioid, RGB, Black
detail.overview: The Ant Esports WENTE 220 is a standalone USB condenser microphone built for streamers, podcasters and gamers who want impressive sound quality without a complex audio setup. Its cardioid polar pattern captures clear, focused sound from the front while suppressing background noise, and a built-in gain knob lets you fine-tune input sensitivity on the fly. A touch-mute button on top instantly mutes or unmutes with an LED indicator confirming status (blue for live, red for muted), and a built-in anti-vibration shock mount plus pop filter reduce handling noise and plosive sounds for cleaner recordings. A 3.5mm headphone jack enables zero-latency real-time monitoring, and true USB plug-and-play connectivity works across PC, Mac and even PS4 with no drivers required.
